rationale: Eggerthella lenta ferments glucose, arabinose, and lactate anaerobically to acetate, formate, and CO₂. With abundant glucose (25 mM), lactate (28 mM), and arginine (22 mM), I prioritize these substrates. Growth rate of 0.45 /h is realistic for anaerobic fermentation; carbon balance: 93 mmol C in supports 14.85 mmol C for growth + 78 mmol C for fermentation products. Nitrogen from arginine and ammonium supports biosynthesis; excess N released as ammonia.
